## This week

When one context holds too many roles, the work splits: several agents — each a Week 4 loop with its own prompt, context, and tools — cooperating through explicit handoffs or a shared store. The four recurring patterns, context isolation as the payoff and invisible omission as the price, MCP as the standardized agent–tool seam, and the adoption rule: split against a measured bottleneck, never by default.
